reading_note: The teaching describes the spiritual process by which nascent goods and truths (new buds) are conceived in the lowest degrees of the mind (the elements), formed and nourished by the conjunction of love's warmth and truth's containing coolness, but then suffer corruption when self-love (Hyle) inundates the natural with its shadow of falsity, blighting the works (fruits) that should grow on every perception (tree). The arc moves: germination → formation in the five degrees → nourishment by warmth and cold → privation/affliction → invasion by evil's energy → casting of shadow → destruction of fruits across all perceptions.
